maps.handoff: Derives a reduced Step 3 posting view and a separate source-bearing analysis request from the selected posting.

maps.title: Step 3 Work Universe
maps.role: Work Universe, evidence workspace and review-output map after a selected posting or role run.
maps.handoff: Receives a Step 1a role query or the reduced Step 3 posting view produced from a Step 2 selection.

implementationCommit.role: Source evidence baseline inspected for current Step 3 behaviour.
verifiedBy: source inspection of v3.1/src/ReviewStudio.jsx and v3.1/src/work-universe

deploymentStatus.notes: Commit statuses report successful deployment processing. This is not physical-runtime verification.

physicalRuntimeVerification.notes: The map includes committed Chromium fixture evidence, not a physical-device production verification.

connections.contract: Step 1a provides the role title/query; Step 2 must not convert SSOC suggestion state into a source-posting prefilter.

Step 2 selected-posting Analyse derives a reduced Step 3 view containing title, employer, skills, combined text and salary midpoint; uuid, URL, employer identities and source are supplied separately to the analysis request.

contracts.statement: Every map entry separates implementation commit, merge commit, deployment status and physical-runtime verification.
Feature-map work must preserve v3/ and Railway configuration unless explicitly requested otherwise.
